We need to fix compilation errors. The test uses Mockito annotations, but we can avoid using Mockito. Simplify: remove mock fields and Mockito usage. Since the test only uses executionContext and executionConfig, which are simple stub classes, we can instantiate directly without mocks. Remove @Mock annotations and imports. Also remove ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class). Also remove Mockito.reset calls. Also remove when() stubbing. In setupBeforeEach, they attempted to stub executionContext.getExecutionConfig() but we will just instantiate SimpleExecutionContext and SimpleExecutionConfig directly, no need for mocks. So modify setupBeforeEach to just create new SimpleExecutionConfig and SimpleExecutionContext, set config.

Also need to adjust SimpleExecutionConfig implements ExecutionConfig: ExecutionConfig is likely an interface in library; we need to implement required methods. The interface may have other methods; but we only need the ones used: isAnnotationCollectionEnabled, getAnnotationCollectionFilter. That's fine.

Similarly SimpleExecutionContext implements ExecutionContext: need getExecutionConfig method; maybe also other methods but not needed.

Also TestValidator extends BaseJsonValidator: super constructor signature may be different. In code they used super(schemaLocation, evaluationPath, schemaNode, parentSchema, validatorTypeCode, validatorTypeCode, validationContext, false); The actual BaseJsonValidator constructor may be different. Let's check typical signature: In networknt json-schema-validator library, BaseJsonValidator has constructor:

protected BaseJsonValidator(SchemaLocation schemaLocation, JsonNodePath evaluationPath, JsonNode schemaNode,
        JsonSchema parentSchema, ValidatorTypeCode validatorTypeCode, ValidationContext validationContext) { ... }

Later versions added boolean isNullable? Not sure. Let's search memory: In version 1.0.70? I recall BaseJsonValidator has constructor:

protected BaseJsonValidator(SchemaLocation schemaLocation, JsonNodePath evaluationPath, JsonNode schemaNode,
        JsonSchema parentSchema, ValidatorTypeCode validatorTypeCode, ValidationContext validationContext) {
    this(schemaLocation, evaluationPath, schemaNode, parentSchema, validatorTypeCode, validatorTypeCode, validationContext);
}

Actually there is another constructor with two validatorTypeCodes for deprecated? Not sure.

But compile errors earlier were about interface expected for ExecutionConfig and ExecutionContext, not about super constructor. So maybe ExecutionConfig and ExecutionContext are interfaces, not classes, so our SimpleExecutionConfig implements ExecutionConfig, okay.

But we need to import ExecutionConfig, ExecutionContext, etc. Already imported via package com.networknt.schema.* maybe.

Now we need to adjust imports: remove org.mockito.* imports.

Also remove @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) annotation.

Remove @Mock fields: schemaLocation, evaluationPath, schemaNode, parentSchema, validatorTypeCode, validationContext, executionContext, executionConfig. Instead we will have fields executionContext, executionConfig as simple objects (no mocks). The test methods use executionContext variable set in setupBeforeEach, and executionConfig set via executionContext.getExecutionConfig(). So we need fields: private SimpleExecutionContext executionContext; private SimpleExecutionConfig executionConfig; Not annotated.

Also remove Mockito.reset calls.

Now adjust code where they reference executionContext and executionConfig fields. Since they are of type SimpleExecutionContext and SimpleExecutionConfig, but method signatures expect ExecutionContext and ExecutionConfig. That's fine because they implement interfaces.

Now adjust imports: need java.util.*; import com.networknt.schema.*; import org.junit.jupiter.api.*; import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*; import java.util.function.Predicate; import java.util.Objects;

Now need to adjust collectAnnotations call: validator.collectAnnotations(executionContext, "anyKeyword") is protected method in BaseJsonValidator. Since test is in same package com.networknt.schema, it can access protected method (protected allows package access). So okay.

Now we need to ensure TestValidator overrides required abstract methods. BaseJsonValidator is abstract and requires methods: getKeyword, getEvaluationPath, validate(ExecutionContext, JsonNode), maybe other overloads. In code they added both signatures. Might compile.

But BaseJsonValidator also defines getSchemaLocation, getSchemaNode, getParentSchema, getEvaluationParentSchema maybe abstract. They return null.

Now we need to ensure imports for JsonNodePath, JsonNode, JsonSchema, ValidatorTypeCode, ValidationContext, ExecutionContext, ExecutionConfig, SchemaLocation. Already present.

Now adjust class fields: remove @Mock annotations.

Now adjust setupBeforeEach: just create new SimpleExecutionConfig and SimpleExecutionContext and set.

Now adjust teardownAfterEach: we can just set fields to null or nothing; remove Mockito.reset.

Now adjust any references to when() and Mockito; remove.

Now compile.

The SimpleExecutionContext implements ExecutionContext, which may have other methods like getExecutionConfig, maybe getValidatorFactory? Not needed.
